# awscc_chime_voice_connector (Resource)

An Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector configuration, including outbound host name and encryption settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Voice Connector.
- `require_encryption` (Boolean) Enables or disables encryption for the Voice Connector.

### Optional

- `aws_region` (String) The AWS Region in which the Voice Connector is created.
- `network_type` (String) The type of network for the Voice Connector.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags assigned to the Voice Connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_timestamp` (String) The Voice Connector creation timestamp, in ISO 8601 format.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `outbound_host_name` (String) The outbound host name for the Voice Connector.
- `updated_timestamp` (String) The Voice Connector updated timestamp, in ISO 8601 format.
- `voice_connector_arn` (String) The ARN of the Voice Connector.
- `voice_connector_id` (String) The Voice Connector ID.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_chime_voice_connector.example
  identity = {
    voice_connector_arn = "voice_connector_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `voice_connector_arn` (String) The ARN of the Voice Connector

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_chime_voice_connector.example
  id = "voice_connector_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_chime_voice_connector.example "voice_connector_arn"
```
